_source: Stage 5a ghost movement (Demo Specification §8.7). Provisional tuning. speed: floor units per real second (0.55 -> 0.35, user 2026-11-15). slowest_in_order: speed factor in a room in perfect order (clean, lit, warm, nothing broken); 1 in a fully run-down room, in between by RoomCondition (user decision 2026-11-15). Metres (2026-11-20, rooms of real sizes): speed in metres per real second, interact_range in metres; converted from floor units at 5 m (a mid-sized room).
